title: Statement and model freeze for conditional classical 128-bit security

target.name: Target S
target.definition: Adv_imp <= 2^-128 for any classical adversary with t_A <= 2^128 and q_A <= 2^128

resources.M_B: formula S.4; no concrete bound; no 64GiB transfer

assumption_F.statement: For fixed C, uniform full-rank H, e <- U(S_C), s=He, every classical algorithm B with work <= 2^166 and RO queries <= 2^164.4 succeeds with probability <= 2^-136.
assumption_F.memory: unbounded as stated; add M_F if aligned with G2 64GiB

wp2_supersession.reason: WP1 recorded two tightenings (hiding 2*q_A/2^rho, binding q_A^2/2^h). WP2 showed both are unsound: the random oracle is a single fixed function for the whole experiment, so every one of the R=1+J+3N executions of A issues fresh queries against the same hidden salt. Live count is Q, not q_A. Counterexamples C.1 and C.2 are written in WP2_LEDGER.md sections 3 and 4.

ledger.hiding_log2.note: wp1 value used the inadmissible q_A-only count; correct value at rho=320 would be -118.33816623093549

ledger.binding_log2.note: wp1 value used the inadmissible q_A^2 count, which is -257 as written; binom(Q,2)/2^h applies

ledger.binding_h448_log2.note: 2*q_A^2/2^448 style figure replaced by binom(Q,2)/2^448; crosses 2^-128, hence withdrawal

gates.WP2.wp1: Prove tightened salt-guess and binding lemmas; non-core <= 2^-149.5
gates.WP2.wp2: DONE - tightenings disproved, correct bounds proved, non-core 2^-149.749 <= 2^-149.5

gates.WP5.wp2: re-measure at n=1024,N=256,h=512,rho=384; salt 48B, digest 64B, commitment leg 192B

wp2_supersession.conclusion_unchanged: Theorem S still reads Adv_imp <= 2^-128 under Assumption F(2^166, 2^-136); only rho and the hiding/binding rows move. No pasted paper text changes shape.

decisions.D7: Delta_H is two-world difference; A3 guessing advantage is half

decisions.D9: U=1; multi-user needs a separate union bound
decisions.D10: Ideal RO for the theorem; SHA-256 only for measurement
